title: Show HN: What if the speed of light was 5 km/h?
summary: An interactive web visualization that scales the speed of light to 5 km/h, allowing users to experience relativistic effects like time dilation and length contraction in real-time with everyday objects. The tool runs entirely in the browser using WebGL/Canvas rendering.
problem_solved: Makes abstract relativistic physics concepts viscerally understandable by scaling light speed to human-perceptible velocities.
why_valuable: Transforms intimidating physics concepts into an interactive, explorable experience that builds genuine intuition for relativity.
